title: Monster in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="24" fill="#6ecf68"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#a8e6a0"/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="87" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#4faf4f"/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="87" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#4faf4f"/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="60" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#6ecf68" transform="rotate(-20 20 60)"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="60" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#6ecf68" transform="rotate(20 80 60)"/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d="M26 50 Q50 58 74 50 L74 58 Q50 66 26 58 Z" fill="#ff5c5c"/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d="M66 55 L74 74 L64 72 L60 56 Z" fill="#ff7b7b"/>
  <!-- scarf fringe -->
  <rect x="63" y="72" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <rect x="69" y="73" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d="M34 36 L30 22 L42 32 Z" fill="#c98aff"/>
  <path d="M66 36 L70 22 L58 32 Z" fill="#c98aff"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="44" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="44" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="45" r="3" fill="#2b4a7a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="45" r="3" fill="#2b4a7a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="43.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="43.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M42 55 Q50 62 58 55" fill="none" stroke="#3b8a3b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <path d="M45 56 L46 60 L48 56 Z" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <path d="M52 56 L53 60 L55 56 Z" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="50" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ff9bb5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="50" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ff9bb5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="70" r="3" fill="#4faf4f"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="72" r="3" fill="#4faf4f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="78" r="3" fill="#8adf82"/>
</svg>
